VisionTrack Limited.main_product: AI video telematics and connected fleet data platform
VisionTrack Limited.reason: VisionTrack's primary product offering and core business revolve around its enterprise cloud-based AI video telematics platform, IoT hardware (dashcams/mobile DVRs), and connected vehicle data software built specifically for fleet management, risk mitigation, and insurance reduction.

Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd.main_product: In-house developed GPS vehicle tracking and fleet telematics platform (MST Web / MST Mobile).
Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd.reason: Mobil Information Systems (Mobil-i) is dedicated entirely to vehicle telematics, real-time GPS tracking, video telematics, and tachograph compliance. Its core business and majority of revenue stem from its proprietary MST suite of fleet management tools.

TT-Matics.main_product: Vehicle telematics and GPS fleet tracking
TT-Matics.reason: TT-Matics is an independent UK-based specialist whose core business is providing vehicle tracking systems, GPS fleet tracking solutions, and integrated dashcam telematics.
